pages.text: The Brigantine and Galleon have a $(l)brig$(). When $(l)most of the crew$() votes for it, a crewmate is locked in. Vote on the quest table's $(l)Crew$() tab or with $(l)/crew brig$(); vote again to take it back.

In the brig you can't work the ship, but you can still bail with a bucket. Explosions don't reach in. You respawn there, and you're put straight back if you get out.$(br2)After a few minutes the crew can vote you out again ($(l)/crew release <player>$(); your own vote counts). Leaving the crew ends it too.
